card.name: Inside drug and route names
card.fires_on: Partway through a longer drug or route word, such as Art-ic-aine, ULTR-AV-IST, intr-av-aginal and pharmac-ologic. It fires on the middle piece, before the word is finished.

modes.label: Route word intravaginal
modes.description: The middle piece 'av' inside intravaginal in 'not for oral, ophthalmic, or intravaginal use'.
modes.example: Miconazole nitrate, zinc oxide and white petrolatum ointment is not for oral, ophthalmic, or intr<<av>>aginal use. ( 2 )

card.writes: It mainly adds the middle of a longer word, with little link to treatment words, which are suppressed.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long drug or route names, like articaine, Ultravist and intravaginal, before the word ends.
